critical_path.title: Successful Login with Valid Credentials and 'Remember Me' Checked
critical_path.description: Verifies that a user can successfully log in with valid credentials and the 'Remember Me' checkbox selected, and that the session persists after closing and reopening the browser.

steps.action: Navigate to the login page.
steps.expected: Login page is displayed.

steps.action: Enter valid username into the 'username' field.
steps.expected: Username is entered in the username field.

steps.action: Enter valid password into the 'password' field.
steps.expected: Password is entered in the password field.

steps.action: Check the 'Remember Me' checkbox.
steps.expected: 'Remember Me' checkbox is selected.

steps.action: Click the 'Submit' button.
steps.expected: User is redirected to the dashboard/home page and successfully logged in.

steps.action: Close the browser.
steps.expected: Browser is closed.

steps.action: Reopen the browser and navigate to the application.
steps.expected: User is automatically logged in and redirected to the dashboard/home page.

assertions: User is successfully logged in after submitting valid credentials.
User remains logged in after closing and reopening the browser.

critical_path.title: Failed Login with Invalid Credentials
critical_path.description: Verifies that the system correctly rejects login attempts with invalid credentials and displays an appropriate error message.

steps.action: Navigate to the login page.
steps.expected: Login page is displayed.

steps.action: Enter an invalid username into the 'username' field.
steps.expected: Invalid username is entered in the username field.

steps.action: Enter an invalid password into the 'password' field.
steps.expected: Invalid password is entered in the password field.

steps.action: Click the 'Submit' button.
steps.expected: User remains on the login page.

steps.action: Verify the presence of an error message.
steps.expected: An error message is displayed indicating incorrect username or password.

assertions: User is not logged in after submitting invalid credentials.
An appropriate error message is displayed to the user.

validation.title: Invalid Login Attempts and Account Lockout
validation.description: Verify that the system locks the account after a defined number of failed login attempts using invalid credentials.

steps.action: Enter an invalid username in the 'username' field.
steps.expected: Username field accepts invalid characters

steps.action: Enter an invalid password in the 'password' field.
steps.expected: Password field accepts invalid characters

steps.action: Click the 'submit' button.
steps.expected: An error message is displayed indicating incorrect credentials.

steps.action: Repeat steps 1-3 for a predefined number of times (e.g., 5) exceeding the lockout threshold.
steps.expected: Error message is displayed indicating that the account is locked due to too many failed attempts.

steps.action: Attempt to log in with valid credentials after the lockout period.
steps.expected: An error message is displayed indicating that the account is locked, and the user needs to wait or initiate a password reset.

steps.action: Wait for the lockout period to expire (e.g., 30 minutes).
steps.expected: Lockout period should expire without administrative intervention.

steps.action: Attempt to log in with valid credentials after the lockout period.
steps.expected: User should be able to login successfully with correct credentials after the lockout period expires.

assertions: Account is locked after exceeding the maximum failed login attempts.
Informative error message is displayed upon account lockout.
Account is unlocked automatically after the lockout period without administrative intervention.
Valid users cannot log in with valid credentials while the account is locked

validation.title: Password Reset Flow - Verify Reset Link Expiry
validation.description: Verify that the password reset link expires after a defined period and cannot be used to reset the password.

steps.action: Navigate to the password reset page.
steps.expected: Password reset page is displayed.

steps.action: Enter a valid username in the 'username' field.
steps.expected: Username field accepts valid characters

steps.action: Request a password reset link.
steps.expected: A password reset link is sent to the user's registered email address.

steps.action: Do not click on the password reset link immediately.
steps.expected: The password reset link remains valid during this period.

steps.action: Wait for the predefined expiry period of the password reset link (e.g., 1 hour).
steps.expected: The system should prevent usage of the link after this time.

steps.action: Click on the password reset link after the expiry period.
steps.expected: The system should display an error message indicating that the link has expired.

steps.action: Attempt to reset the password using the expired link.
steps.expected: Password reset fails and user should be prompted to request a new password reset link.

assertions: Password reset link expires after the defined period.
Informative error message is displayed when using an expired password reset link.
User is unable to reset the password using an expired link.

error_handling.title: Invalid Login Attempts and Account Lockout
error_handling.description: Tests the account lockout mechanism after multiple failed login attempts with incorrect credentials to prevent brute-force attacks.

steps.action: Enter invalid username 'invalid_user'
steps.expected: Username field accepts input

steps.action: Enter invalid password 'wrong_password'
steps.expected: Password field accepts input

steps.action: Click 'Submit' button
steps.expected: Login fails

steps.action: Repeat steps 1-3 five times with different invalid passwords.
steps.expected: Login fails with each attempt until the last one

steps.action: On the sixth attempt, enter invalid username 'invalid_user'
steps.expected: Username field accepts input

steps.action: Enter invalid password 'another_wrong_password'
steps.expected: Password field accepts input

steps.action: Click 'Submit' button
steps.expected: Account is locked out. An error message is displayed indicating the account is locked, and instructions on how to unlock it are provided. The user is unable to log in.

steps.action: After a specified lockout duration (e.g., 15 minutes), attempt to log in again with correct credentials.
steps.expected: Login succeeds, or an error message indicates the account is still locked if lockout duration has not expired.

steps.action: After the lockout duration has expired, attempt to log in again with correct credentials
steps.expected: Login succeeds and account is successfully unlocked

assertions: Account is locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
Clear error message displayed indicating the reason for lockout and remediation steps.
User is unable to log in with any credentials (valid or invalid) while the account is locked.
Account lockout duration is enforced.
Account is automatically unlocked after the specified duration.

error_handling.title: Password Reset Flow - Invalid Email/Username
error_handling.description: Tests the password reset flow when an invalid email address or username is entered.  Verifies appropriate error handling and prevents information disclosure.

steps.action: Navigate to the 'Forgot Password' page.
steps.expected: The 'Forgot Password' page is displayed.

steps.action: Enter an invalid email address (e.g., 'invalid_email@example.invalid') in the email/username field.
steps.expected: Email/username field accepts the input.

steps.action: Click the 'Submit' or 'Reset Password' button.
steps.expected: Request is submitted.

steps.action: Verify the response.
steps.expected: A generic error message is displayed (e.g., 'If an account with this email address exists, we have sent a password reset link.') or 'Invalid username or email.' Prevents the application revealing if the email is registered or not. No email is sent.

steps.action: Repeat steps 2-4 with an invalid username (e.g., 'invalid_user').
steps.expected: A generic error message is displayed (e.g., 'If an account with this username exists, we have sent a password reset link.') or 'Invalid username or email.' Prevents the application revealing if the username is registered or not. No email is sent.

assertions: A generic error message is displayed when an invalid email address or username is entered.
No password reset email is sent to an invalid email address.
The system does not reveal whether the entered email address or username exists in the system.
The error message is user-friendly and does not contain technical details.
